source: cantilevered plate under a uniform load (distributed-load cantilever family)
notes: The top face shares its wall edge with the support, so 1.3% of the load lands on fixed nodes (R005 warning); that is what a uniform load on the whole surface means.

adjudication.comment: Whole-top load is consistent. A surface load can share fixed-edge nodes; do not call the finite nodal fraction a continuum area fraction.
